shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in app/Dashboard.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json CLAUDE.md; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls app/api 2>&1; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>&1 | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -ril "promise.all" . | head; grep -rl "headers()" . | head -5
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo tsc=$?; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
git diff --stat; git checkout -- tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; git status --short
